land_definition: HEIGHT >= 16, fixed_map.py _land_count and iso kWaterline. Not HEIGHT > 0 and not the classifier at average 19.

scale_from_03.conflict: Ten 256-square islands are 10*65536 tiles. The proportional scale of the reference mix does not yield a 256-count of 10. Keeping both the reference rectangle share and the proportional filler counts is not possible.

owner_10x256_coverage_matched_filler.note: 10 large islands, filler counts scaled so rectangle tiles stay near the reference share

owner_10x256_plus_proportional_filler.note: keeps the scaled 64/80/128 counts and replaces the scaled 256 count with 10

centre_spacing_milli.definition: nearest neighbour of rectangle centres, floor(euclidean*1000); Clark-Evans has no edge correction; R>1 is more even than Poisson

nearest_gap.definition: per island, minimum floored Euclidean edge gap to another rectangle; median_low; p10 index is floor(0.10*(n-1))
